newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Kian Ho says 1997 regional outlook poor.
newsitem.headline: Kian Ho says 1997 regional outlook poor.

text.p: Kian Ho Bearings Ltd said on Friday it expected profits to be lower in 1997 than in 1996.
The company said a statement accompanying its interim results that first half profits had been hit by its performance in regional markets.

"In view of the economic environment and difficult operating conditions in the region this year, the directors expect the profit for the current financial year to be lower than the previous financial year," the statement said.
Kian Ho reported net interim earnings of Singapore $1.43 million, down 39 percent from S$2.36 million previously.
Lower sales in Indonesia, a weakened Thai economy, a slower than expected recovery in Singapore's electronics industry and higher operating costs were the main factors for the fall, the firm said.
